catalog.sourcePartitionScope: Primary RAY source only; the separate interpreted neck volume has its own source and bounded native clip.

changes: Dedicated left-facing native Liquid Ocelot RAY MGS4, without reusing MGS2/MGR or mirroring the REX camera.
Fixed-length planted-foot motion, bounded mechanical root travel, head and jaw pivots on visible hardware.
RAY water cutter uses the drawn native nozzle, locked aim target, mechanical angle limits, warning/active/recovery clocks and the same ray for visual and collision.
RAY body charge advances actual articulated mass instead of emitting a detached generic charge ball; existing ARMURE/NOYAU health pools and progression stay intact.
Port Area generated from actual PS3 reference frames, with two source PNGs and three independently moving depth planes.
OPTIONS saved reduced-motion preference reaches Archive and disables decorative parallax.
Native duel pause via button, P and Escape freezes the actual gameplay, particles, support and scene clocks, with accessible resume/Command dialog.
Original Pass31 controller and old source art remain physically present.
A dedicated generated internal neck yoke fills the physically observed exposed joint during aiming, fitted uniformly beneath the original armor without changing its source pixels.
Wing/hip ownership boundaries follow actual transparent gaps, so the leg armor follows the leg instead of remaining attached to a wing.

validation.nativeGeometry: passed: original native source partition, two fixed-length leg chains, planted contacts, pure weapon getters and underlay texture rotation
validation.actualBrowserFlows: passed: two actual Shadow Ops menu/control stories; normal and saved reduced preference; REX walk/three weapons, RAY water/charge, pause and return

limits: Reference-led generated painted 2D reconstruction; extracted original 3D animation, texels and absolute1:1 fidelity are not certified.
Only REX right-facing damaged and RAY left-facing native cameras are admitted; hidden views are not mirrored.
Only the visible RAY water emitter is newly admitted. Missile caps and other weapon-port animations remain unadmitted.
No new per-wing destructible HP pools, canonical final dismemberment or alternate source frame is invented.
Port Area parallax, floor projection, RAY charge and attack timings are authored CQC adaptations. Falling snow is disabled because the selected still frames do not establish its timing.
The internal neck volume is an interpreted reference-led generated subassembly, not a hidden original surface extracted from the game.
